verdict.reason: The implementation handles the edge.label placeholder for many center labels, but it does not fully implement the claimed global horizontal painted frontier. Root class SVEK x-normalization still has a non-painted 0.0 lower bound when diagram.together is empty. A valid note-only link-note perturbation makes the relationship center note the leftmost visible primitive; Java normalizes from the painted note path at x=6, while Rust keeps a 5px unpainted frontier and paints the note at x=11. This is inside the account scope and is not attributable to endpoint labels or route serialization.
verdict.required_followup: Before acceptance, the model needs an account and implementation for root class SVEK x-normalization that removes or justifies the non-painted zero seed under Java's LimitFinder(initToZero=false) semantics, then reruns this preserved perturbation matrix with a separate checker.
